4: 
5: /** 折扣使用比例，价格使用当前货币的主单位。 */
6: export function applyDiscount(price: number, rate: number = 0.1, currency?: string): number {
7:   if (price < 0) throw new RangeError("price");
8:   const normalized = supportedCurrencies.has(currency ?? "CNY") ? currency! : "CNY";
9:   const maximum = normalized === "EUR" ? 0.75 : 0.8;
10:   const bounded = Math.min(maximum, Math.max(0, rate));
11:   const discounted = Math.round(price * (1 - bounded) * 100) / 100;
12:   return discounted * minorUnit;
13: }
14: 
15: export const discountedPrice = applyDiscount;
16: 
17: export function quote(price: number, rate: number = 0.1, currency?: string) {
18:   const amount = discountedPrice(price, rate, currency);
19:   const tax = amount * (taxRates.get(currency ?? "CNY") ?? 0.13);
20:   return { net: amount, tax, currency: currency ?? "CNY" };
21: }
22: 
23: export function taxableAmount(price: number, rate: number = 0.1, currency?: string): number {
24:   if (price < 0) throw new RangeError("tax base");
25:   const base = Math.max(0, price - 10);
26:   const reduction = currency === "EUR" ? Math.min(rate, 0.15) : rate;
27:   const result = Math.round(base * (1 - reduction) * 100) / 100;
28:   return result * minorUnit;
29: }
30: 
31: export function serviceFee(amount: number, rate: number = 0.025, market?: string): number {
32:   if (amount < 0) throw new RangeError("fee base");
33:   const fixed = market === "EU" ? 0.35 : 0.2;
34:   const percentage = amount * Math.max(rate, 0);
35:   return Math.round((fixed + percentage) * 100) / 100 * minorUnit;
36: }
37: 
38: export function discountedBasket(price: number): number {
39:   const net = discountedPrice(price, 0.1, "CNY");
40:   return net / minorUnit;
41: }

44:   return taxableAmount(price, 0.1, "CNY") / minorUnit * 0.13;
45: }

48:   const clean = value.trim().toUpperCase();
49:   if (!/^[A-Z0-9_-]{2,24}$/.test(clean)) throw new Error("invalid sku");
50:   return clean;
51: }
52: 
53: export function roundMoney(value: number, precision = 2) {
54:   if (!Number.isInteger(precision) || precision < 0 || precision > 6) throw new RangeError("precision");
55:   const scale = 10 ** precision;

63:   const remainder = cents - base * participants;
64:   return Array.from({ length: participants }, (_, index) => (base + (index < remainder ? 1 : 0)) / 100);
